note: None of jobId, allFailed or allWaiting. The oneOf makes the discriminator mandatory — an empty payload must not be readable as 'retry everything'.
Both jobId and allFailed. Ambiguous intent: a consumer would have to choose between one job and all of them, so the schema refuses rather than letting each implementation pick.
Both jobId and allWaiting. The same ambiguity as with allFailed.
Both allFailed and allWaiting. Repairing a shared cause and hurrying a backoff are two decisions; a producer wanting both sends two requests.
allFailed: false. The const pins it to true so the member means 'do the bulk operation' and never 'do something else'; a false here is a client that meant to send jobId.
allWaiting: false. Pinned to true for the same reason as allFailed.
Empty jobId. minLength 1 stops a dropped identifier arriving as a well-formed request naming nothing.
Unknown top-level member — additionalProperties: false catches `force`, which a caller might assume would also release a held job. Nothing does.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
